question: Arubathu Moovar festival is annually celebrated in the Indian state of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arubathu Moovar** was **celebrated in Chennai (Tamil Nadu).**
 
• The** Arubathu Moovar festival **is an annual festival of **carrying 63 Nayanmars in a procession** as part of the **Panguni Uthiram Peruvizha – Festival **in Sri Mylai **Kapaleeshwarar Temple/Mylapore Kapaleeswarar Temple.**
 
• The** Panguni Peruvizha chariot festival **is dedicated to** Lord Shiva, which happens during the Tamil month **of Panguni (between March – April), and is part of the nine-day festival celebrated to honor the **Saivite devotees, namely the sixty-three Nayanmars (saints).**
 
• The** Nayanmars are the leading figures** and poets of the **South Indian Saiva Siddhanta system.**
 
• The entire streets around **Mylapore Kapaleeshwarar temple** are filled with devotees to witness the** Arupathumoovar Vizha **and take part in this festival with cheerfulness and energy.
